core.headline: Mid-terrace house, Wren Close, Dartford DA1
core.summary: Shared Ownership mid-terrace house in Dartford with two bedrooms, rear garden and two parking spaces. The price is for a 40% share; rent £487 per month on the unsold share; full market value £325,000.
core.listing:
A mid-terrace house with two bedrooms at Wren Close, Dartford DA1. The price is Shared Ownership £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent is £487 per month on the unsold share. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining, peppercorn ground rent and a service charge of £312 per year (2026/27 estimate).

The accommodation comprises one reception room and one bathroom. The property has a rear garden. Two parking spaces are provided on the driveway.

Electricity, water and sewerage are mains. Water is metered. Heating is gas central heating. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal shows good outdoor coverage on major networks.

The price is Shared Ownership £130,000 for a 40% share; rent £487 per month on the unsold share; full market value £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining, peppercorn ground rent and a service charge of £312 per year (2026/27 estimate). Council Tax is band C (Dartford Borough Council). The EPC rating is B. Shared ownership eligibility criteria apply. The housing association has an 8-week nomination period on resale.
